title: Model failover queue
desc: After saving, this queue is frozen into newly created Nomi AgentSession routes; existing Sessions stay unchanged. The runtime switches candidates in order on pre-response rate-limit, 5xx, or network faults.
queueHint: New Sessions try enabled candidates head-to-tail when they satisfy the current turn; duplicates of the primary model are removed.
empty: No candidates yet. Add a provider + model below.
duplicate: That provider + model is already in the queue.
maxSwitchesHint: Upper bound on switches within a single turn (also capped by the queue length).
